suspects.description: Pointer value `(&stack0xffffff4c + (uint)bVar6 * -8 + (uint)bVar6 * -8)` truncated by cast to `int` (sub-pointer width) — correct on the 32-bit matching build, a hard `cast from pointer to smaller type` error at 64-bit. If the value is used as an integer (delta, address print, hash), rewrite the cast as `uintptr_t`/`intptr_t` in a .keep.
